name: HeyGen (formerly Movio)
summary: HeyGen is a text-to-video platform that uses AI avatars and lip-sync to create videos from scripts, PowerPoints, or URLs. Features real-time video translation and voice cloning.
description: HeyGen is a text-to-video platform that uses AI avatars and lip-sync to create videos from scripts, PowerPoints, or URLs. Features real-time video translation and voice cloning. Be your best self, every time. Create clear, confident AI videos with your Personal Avatar—your face and voice, without filming every video. Try it free. AI avatar generation: Choose from a diverse range of digital humans to present your content, offering a professional and engaging delivery. Real-time translation: Instantly translate and dub your videos into multiple languages, breaking down language barriers for a global audience. Voice cloning: Use your own voice or select from a library of synthesized voices, enabling consistent branding and personal connection. Script-to-video: Convert text, slides, or even URLs directly into compelling video content, streamlining the content creation process.

howToUse.title: Sign Up & Access Dashboard
howToUse.description: Go to HeyGen's website and sign up for a free or premium account. After verifying your email, log in to access the dashboard.

howToUse.title: Start a New Project
howToUse.description: Click 'Create Video' or 'New Project'. Choose from blank, script, PowerPoint, or URL input to start. You can also select a template suited for your use case.

howToUse.title: Select Your AI Avatar
howToUse.description: Browse the avatar library and pick a digital presenter that matches your target audience and tone. Premium users unlock more avatar options.

howToUse.title: Input Script or Content
howToUse.description: Paste your script, upload a PowerPoint, or enter a URL. HeyGen will extract text and generate scenes based on your input. Edit each scene’s text as needed.

howToUse.title: Choose Voice and Language
howToUse.description: Select the AI voice and adjust language, accent, speed, and tone. Use the voice cloning feature if you want to use your own or a custom voice.

howToUse.title: Customize Video Scenes
howToUse.description: Add or customize backgrounds, upload images, use HeyGen's stock assets, and arrange avatars and text. Adjust timing and transitions for each scene.

howToUse.title: Translate or Dub Video (Optional)
howToUse.description: Enable the translation feature to automatically translate and dub your video into other languages. Review the translated script and voices before generating.

howToUse.title: Preview and Revise
howToUse.description: Preview the full video, check lip-sync, transitions, voice, and adjust any elements as needed. Make sure all scenes and text are accurate.

howToUse.title: Export & Download
howToUse.description: Choose your export format and resolution (some options may require a premium plan). Download the MP4 or share directly to social or business platforms.

howToUse.title: Explore Advanced Features & API
howToUse.description: Try batch video creation, API integrations, or advanced branding and voice options for automation or large-scale production.

features_fr: Génération d'avatars IA : choisissez parmi un large éventail d'humains numériques pour présenter votre contenu, offrant une diffusion professionnelle et engageante.
Traduction en temps réel : traduisez et doublez instantanément vos vidéos dans plusieurs langues, éliminant ainsi les barrières linguistiques pour un public mondial.
Clonage vocal : utilisez votre propre voix ou sélectionnez-la dans une bibliothèque de voix synthétisées, permettant une image de marque cohérente et une connexion personnelle.
Script en vidéo : convertissez du texte, des diapositives ou même des URL directement en contenu vidéo convaincant, rationalisant ainsi le processus de création de contenu.
